visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a traditional Chinese ink wash animation. A man in a conical hat stands on a small wooden boat, navigating a calm river. In the background, majestic blue-toned mountains rise into a misty sky, and a flock of birds flies across the upper frame. (2) A sharp cut to real-world footage shows a middle-aged man lying in a bed with blue lighting. He is visibly distressed, grimacing and clutching his shoulder in physical pain. The setting is a dimly lit bedroom environment. (3) The camera focuses on a close-up of a hand holding a traditional calligraphy brush. The brush, soaked in black ink, moves gracefully across a sheet of white paper, creating cursive Chinese characters. The lighting is natural and bright on the workspace. (4) Several rapid cuts show different angles of the calligraphy process, focusing on the movement of the brush tip. Eventually, the camera pans over a completed scroll of long, vertical lines of text on textured paper. (5) The video concludes with a solid yellow graphic screen. A stylized dark snake icon with a purple body appears at the bottom right. Bold black text is centered, and a detailed reference list with small white text is visible in the lower-left corner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a serene flute melody playing over gentle, plucked string notes. A male narrator begins speaking in a calm, professional narrative tone. Subdued sounds of water rippling and distant birds chirping are layered into the environmental mix to match the visual river scene. (2) As the narrator describes physical pain, the music remains consistent, but the narrator’s delivery becomes slightly more somber and empathetic. The environmental water and bird sounds fade out, replaced by clean studio silence behind the vocal and background music. (3) A clear, percussive scratching sound is heard, representing the friction of a calligraphy brush on paper. This sound effect is synchronized with the close-up visuals. The BGM maintains its relaxed, traditional acoustic tempo while the narrator continues his story. (4) The narrator’s tone lightens slightly during a pun about a historical figure. The background music continues seamlessly without any abrupt shifts. Periodic brush-on-paper SFX provide a rhythmic texture to the audio track. (5) The background music transitions to a more modern, percussive acoustic-pop rhythm with a brighter piano and guitar arrangement. The narrator shifts to a high-dominance, informative tone for the medical call to action, delivering clear, enunciated speech. Technical UI pops and whooshes punctuate the transition to the graphic screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous historical pun involving the figure 'Zhi Tian Xin Chang' (a play on Oda Nobunaga) to raise awareness about shingles (herpes zoster). It transitions from a fictional/traditional anecdote about calligraphy and pain to a real-world medical warning, urging viewers to consult professionals to avoid health disruptions.
